mercury: Mercury retrograde: your thinking turns inward, and you weigh things twice before saying them. Being misunderstood may feel familiar; writing comes easier than talking.
venus: Venus retrograde: you give love slowly and with care; what you value is off the beaten path. In love, you carry a theme of settling accounts with the past.
mars: Mars retrograde: you keep your anger and your desires inside and act in roundabout ways. Your energy comes in waves, but it's powerful once it builds up.
jupiter: Jupiter retrograde: you don't take your beliefs from outside; you build them within. For you, luck is a matter of inner wisdom.
saturn: Saturn retrograde: your relationship with authority and responsibility is an inner one; you set your own rules. You're your own harshest judge.
uranus: Uranus retrograde: your rebellion lives inside, quiet and deep; you're different in a way that's understated but deep-rooted.
neptune: Neptune retrograde: your intuition and imagination turn inward; you see through illusions faster than most people.
pluto: Pluto retrograde: your power to transform is inner and hidden; facing your own darkness is your path.
